about: Pronunciation override map for the French voice bake. 'words': whole-word rewrites applied to the TTS text of every line by scripts/voice/extract-lines.mjs frTTS() (regex source + flags, in order). 'lines': a full TTS text for one clip key, applied by scripts/voice/generate.py tts_of() (wins over cast.json ttsOverride). Displayed text and clip keys never change; a changed TTS text changes the line's generation hash, so the next incremental run regenerates exactly the affected clips. 'heard' records what Whisper large-v3 transcribed from the clip when the entry was checked.
